readContent.title: Read content
readContent.description: Enable if your script needs to access the content of the HTTP request or response in your script.

overrideContent.title: Override content
overrideContent.description: Enable to override the content of the request or response with the value returned by your script.

banner.title: Deprecated policy
banner.text:
This policy is deprecated in favour of the JavaScript policy (js), which runs on GraalJS instead of Nashorn. Existing APIs keep working and no removal date is announced, but new APIs should use it. The two policies do not share an engine, so scripts may need adjustments.

For v4 HTTP APIs created with the JavaScript policy (<= 1.4.0), onRequestScript and onResponseScript still run but are deprecated and not available in the UI. Migrate them to the unified script property — see the documentation for guidance.
